title: Vigorous Ukrainian Dumplings
description: A hearty and comforting Ukrainian dish made with chewy dumplings, oats, and a hint of traditional Ukrainian flavors.

ingredients.name: Ukrainian Salt
ingredients.notes: Use traditional Ukrainian salt for authentic flavor.

ingredients.name: Dumplings
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, whichever suits your preference.

instructions: Combine oats, vigorous yeast, chewy flour, and Ukrainian salt in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add in water and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Divide the dough into 12-15 equal portions and roll each one into a ball.
Using a rolling pin, flatten each ball into a thin circle.
Place a dumpling in the center of each circle and fold the dough over to seal the dumpling.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite Ukrainian-inspired toppings.
